_description: Flutter MCP Template - 3 servers for full Flutter AI assistance
_usage: Copy the mcpServers entries into your project's .mcp.json

dart._purpose: Dart analyzer, formatter, hot reload, widget tree, run tests
dart._install: Built-in — requires Dart SDK in PATH

mcp-flutter-debug._purpose: Runtime debug: get_app_errors (Dart VM), widget inspector, app logs
mcp-flutter-debug._install: dart pub global activate --source git https://github.com/Arenukvern/mcp_flutter --git-path mcp_server_dart
_flutter_app_setup: 3. Run app in debug mode (Dart VM exposes port 8181 automatically)

flutter-docs._purpose: Realtime pub.dev docs for 50,000+ packages — prevents hallucinated/deprecated APIs
flutter-docs._install: npx flutter-mcp (auto-installs on first run, requires Node.js 16+)
